'''Leaper''' is a [[enemy]] found in the {{ch|Alley}} and {{ch|Lab}}. It is a big rat that jumps high into the air and slams down onto its foes.

== Behavior ==
Attempts to move within a moderate distance of the player's units, performing a leap attack that deals its damage to all ''adjacent'' (cardinal) units and inflicting knockback, sometimes not necessarily in that order<ref>[https://youtu.be/-IDcSlsHStg?si=J_u1ZPux2CAHRBaq&t=637 Druid's Moth - Analyzing ALL Enemies in THE ALLEY]</ref>. They will priorize attacking multiple units if they are standing each order. This attack cannot target a space occupied by a unit, unlike other similar abilities.

=== Tips ===
* The player should refrain from positioning their units too close to each other, as Leapers will prioritize hitting multiple units at once if they can.
* Its leap attack counts as contact for effects such as {{st|Thorns}}, {{st|Counter Attack}}, etc.
==Ways to obtain==
*Spawned sometimes by {{en|Gamete}} or by destroying pillars in The Lab.
*{{en|Lil' Rat|Lil' Rats}} have a chance to become Leapers if exposed to radiation.
*[[Events]]: {{Event|Dead Rat}} (Bad common options with 'Destroy' or 'Loot', Enemy) and {{Event|Mouse nest}} (Good rare option with 'Charm', Ally).

== Trivia ==
* Leapers, along with Lil' Rats, were one of the very first enemies created, appearing in very early footage of development when the team was still experimenting with the game's playstyle.<ref>https://x.com/TylerGlaiel/status/1172215055401644032</ref>
